propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock due to rebar_repo function scope running git init and repo setup 589 times (306 ms/call, 58 spawns per call).
Session-scoped template built once per xdist worker plus per-test copytree reduces setup from 306 ms to 22.3 ms by eliminating redundant git subprocess spawns.

Linked worktree pointers (.tickets-tracker/.git and gitdir) embed absolute paths and must be rewritten per copy; bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op that leaves copies pointing to template storage.
Snapshot store keyed by commit SHA causes ~150 tests to collide on one template entry and requires per-test REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR to enforce isolation.

Environment identity files (.env-id and .signing-key) must be unconditionally re-randomized per copy (not via idempotency-guarded init._gen_local_files) to prevent worker-wide constants from violating signature locality.
